title: First Financial Corporation Reports Second Quarter Results
summary: TERRE HAUTE, Ind., July 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - First Financial Corporation (NASDAQ:THFF) today announced results for the second quarter of 2026. Net income was $22.7 million compared to $18.6 million reported for the same period of 2025; Diluted net income per common share of $1.91 compared to $1.57 for the same period of 2025; Return on average assets was 1.48% compared to 1.34% for the three months ended June 30, 2025; Provision for credit losses was $1.3 million compared to provision of $2.0 million for the second quarter 2025; and Pre-tax, pre-provision net income was $29.3 million compared to $24.9 million for the same period in 2025. 1 The Corporation further reported results for the six months ended June 30, 2026: Net income was $42.5 million compared to $37.0 million reported for the same period of 2025; Diluted net income per common share of $3.58 compared to $3.12 for the same period of 2025; Return on average assets was 1.42% compared to 1.34% for the
